sblgnt.verdictNote: SBLGNT text is a separately licensed edition subject to the SBLGNT EULA. Under License-Safe Full-Fidelity policy §1.2 (Rights uncertainty = LICENSE_HOLD; do not substitute with a convenient unreviewed source), rights for derivative translation, redistribution, external LLM input, and full-text storage are treated as fail-closed. Boolean fields set to false to reflect the exclusion decision — this is not an assertion of denied permission by SBL, but the admission-side decision that the source is not available for use in the admitted set until an explicit EULA review clears the specific permitted uses.

overallNote: Overall Luke C0 verdict is PASS on the admitted source set (TAGNT + MorphGNT annotations + koreanGloss project-owned). The SBLGNT text component is explicitly excluded from the admitted set and machine-readable exclusion flags are set for candidate generation input, external LLM input, derivative source, redistribution source, and production evidence source. The G2 preparation code path (buildLukeG2Preparation in bible-mindmap/scripts/build-luke-g2-canary-preparation.mjs) already derives verse.text and localWindow from TAGNT tokens (parseTagntLuke) and consumes only MorphGNT morphology/lemmatization rows (parseMorphgntLuke → morphgntCrossCheck), so no SBLGNT text is carried into candidate input or downstream derivative payloads. SBLGNT text is retained only as human reference cross-check. This exclusion decision does not gate G2 execution on SBL EULA review, but any future re-admission of SBLGNT text into the admitted set must pass an explicit EULA review and a new C0 Rights admission cycle.
